issue: Are FBAR penalties 'fines' subject to review under the Eighth Amendment's Excessive Fines Clause?
provision: U.S. Const. amend. VIII (Excessive Fines Clause); 31 U.S.C. § 5321

sides.position: FBAR penalties are not fines within the Excessive Fines Clause, so the clause does not apply to them.
FBAR penalties are in substantial measure punitive and are therefore subject to review under the Excessive Fines Clause.
cases: United States v. Schwarzbaum, 114 F.4th 1319 (11th Cir. 2024)

this_court: FBAR penalties are subject to review under the Eighth Amendment's Excessive Fines Clause.
quote: The only other circuit court to have addressed the question, the First Circuit, recently held that the Eighth Amendment’s Excessive Fines Clause does not apply to FBAR penalties.
cite: United States v. Isac Schwarzbaum, 114 F.4th 1319 (11th Cir. 2024)
